title: Instrumenting Applications with Application Insights
description: Add Application Insights SDK to your application to collect custom and standard telemetry.

data.text: Application Insights supports .NET, Java, JavaScript, Python, and Node.js. The SDK is installed via package manager and initialized with your instrumentation key or connection string.

data.title: Initialize Application Insights (JavaScript)
data.content: Install and configure the SDK in a Node.js application:

data.text: Standard telemetry is useful, but you should also track custom events that matter to your business. For example, track when a user completes a checkout flow or when an AI agent handles a support request.

data.title: Track Custom Events and Metrics (JavaScript)

terms.definition: Log a named event with optional properties for segmentation.
Record a numeric value that can be averaged, summed, or counted over time.
Log a diagnostic message with a severity level.
Log an exception with stack trace and custom properties.

data.title: Track Exceptions (JavaScript)
Avoid PII in Telemetry
data.text: Never log personally identifiable information (PII) such as credit card numbers, social security numbers, or full names. Use sampling to reduce telemetry volume and cost without losing insights.
